# Termihomo v0.4.5

### 修复 / Fixes
- 修复 Linux 登出后再次登录不显示托盘的问题：桌面 D-Bus 连接断开时退出旧托盘进程，释放托盘锁，允许新会话正常启动托盘。
- 保持 Mihomo 内核独立运行，不因桌面会话退出而停止代理服务。

### English
- Fix the missing Linux tray after logging out and back in. Exit the stale tray worker when its desktop D-Bus connection closes, releasing the tray lock for the next session.
- Keep the Mihomo core independent of the desktop tray session.
